card.name: Lifting and hauling equipment in passages
card.fires_on: Words in the middle of phrases about lifting, carrying or hauling things, or about rescue gear such as lifeboats and safety nets. The words are often small ones like 'using', 'by', 'the' or 'life' before the gear is named.

modes.label: Lifting or carrying verbs
modes.description: A linking word right after a verb of lifting, carrying or transporting.
modes.example: The body can then be lifted<< using>> the plastic to hold the remains intact.

modes.label: Rescue and landing gear
modes.description: The first part of a compound gear name such as lifeboat, safety net or landing gear.
modes.example: vessels were obliged to provide a<< life>>boat place for every person on board.

modes.label: Logging and hauling work
modes.description: Small words in descriptions of moving logs or attaching cables.
modes.example: Depending on the size of the logs, up to four logs<< were>> transported in a single work cycle.

card.writes: It pushes toward 'jack' and away from unrelated words, which suggests a lifting-device or hoisting sense.
card.plain: It fires on small words inside phrases about lifting or hauling loads and about rescue equipment.
